messages:
Sam L: Hi payroll — my 3/15 paycheck shows my 401(k) deferral taken as post-tax (Roth) instead of the pre-tax option I selected in self-service. Can someone confirm?
Jade (Payroll): Thanks for flagging. Can you DM your EmpID or last 4 of SSN so we can pull the record and open a ticket? Which pay period was this for?
Sam L: EmpID 005432. Pay period 03/01-03/15. I uploaded a redacted paystub screenshot to the thread.
payroll-bot: Payroll run #2024-03-15 completed for Redwood US. 3,102 employees processed.
Jade (Payroll): Looking at the import logs — benefits enrollment file from 03/10 mapped the 401k code to ROTH instead of PRETAX for your record. That would cause the post-tax deferral.
Maria HR: Yikes. Can you confirm whether this is isolated or batch? We need to know who to notify.
Jade (Payroll): Preliminary query shows 6 additional EmpIDs in the same import batch with the same mapping mis-match. We'll extract the full list and circle back. For you @Sam L we can schedule a retro correction.
Sam L: What does the retro correction do? Will my taxes be fixed or do I need to do anything at tax time?
Jade (Payroll): We'll queue an off-cycle retro to reclassify the 401(k) deferral from post-tax to pre-tax for the affected pay period. That will adjust federal/state taxable wages and withholdings. The correcting transaction will appear on your next paycheck. If any underwithholding results, we'll process a tax adjustment.
Jade (Payroll): Important note: retro corrections change YTD tax amounts and can affect year-end reporting. If year-to-date tax amounts change, we will issue corrected W-2s (W-2c) as required.
Sam L: Do I need to sign anything?
Jade (Payroll): Standard practice is to get employee authorization. I'll DM you a retro authorization form to sign. If you decline the retro we can apply a current-pay correction instead (less tax-accurate).
Maria HR: We'll open a process ticket for the benefits import mapping and request an engineering fix for the mapping table. @Eng Platform FYI — looks like a mapping key change caused this.
Jade (Payroll): Action plan for affected employees: 1) Collect signed retro authorizations. 2) Run batch retro corrections with payroll provider this week. 3) Validate recalculated taxes and post-corrections. 4) Track W-2 impacts and prepare W-2c if necessary.
payroll-bot: Ticket PR-7241 created: "401k import mapping error" assigned to payroll_team. Priority: High.
Jade (Payroll): I'll add the six affected EmpIDs to the ticket and document manual steps in the payroll runbook.
Sam L: Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please ping when my signed form is received.
Jade (Payroll): Sending DM now. Will update the thread once the batch run is scheduled. :thumbsup:
